name: PT Dafam Property Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Dafam Property Indonesia Tbk engages in the property development activities in Indonesia. The company operates through three segments: Hotel, Real Estate, and Hotel Management Services. It develops residential and operates hotels. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Semarang, Indonesia. PT Dafam Property Indonesia Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Dafam.
